canonicalFacts.claim: Evidence-based psychotherapies including cognitive processing therapy, prolonged exposure, and EMDR are first-line treatments for PTSD
Serotonin reuptake inhibitors are established pharmacological treatments for PTSD
PTSD is characterized by re-experiencing, avoidance, negative alterations in cognition and mood, and marked alterations in arousal and reactivity
Insomnia is among the most reported sleep disturbances in PTSD patients and is associated with reduced quality of life and impaired functioning
PTSD can be assessed by structured interviews and screening measures in both psychiatric and nonpsychiatric settings

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Physical activity may help prevent and manage anxiety disorders based on epidemiological data and systematic reviews
